framework: DPDP Act 2023 & DPDPR 2025 Gap & Readiness Register

gaps.finding: Previously, consent withdrawal lacked a direct programmatic state machine and audit log.
gaps.remediation: Implemented RightsService.processErasureRequest and consent withdrawal workflow with cryptographic certification.

gaps.finding: Privacy notice was historically maintained only in English and Hindi, falling short of the Pan-Indian 13-language mandate.
gaps.remediation: Constructed complete statutory privacy notice packs across all 13 official languages: en, hi, te, ta, kn, ml, mr, bn, gu, or, pa, as, ne.

gaps.category: Data Erasure vs Statutory Public Records Invariant
gaps.finding: Lack of architectural clarity on whether a citizen deleting their account could delete statutory ECI election candidate records.
gaps.remediation: Codified clear segregation: statutory public electoral records (canonical_persons, candidate_affidavits, delimitation_lineage) are exempt from DPDP citizen erasure under Representation of the People Act 1951.

gaps.finding: Breach notification protocol had not defined the statutory 72-hour notification SLA to DPBI.
gaps.remediation: Implemented BreachService calculating automated 72-hour statutory deadline for high/critical incidents and simulated DPBI acknowledgment.

legalReviewFlaggedItems.description: Final legal sign-off on interplay between TRAI commercial OBD regulations and ECI silence period rules for campaign broadcasts.

legalReviewFlaggedItems.subject: Aadhaar Voluntary Masked Verification Retention Ceiling
